home and dry phrase

also out of danger, out of the woods, in the clear, safe in harbour, I’m all right, in safe waters

classical

Ter. And. 480: ego in portū nāvigō
Cic. Fam. 9.6.4: in portū esse (Lewis & Short)

in portū nāvigō

I am sailing in harbour: I am out of all danger

(vōx cōmica: Ter.)

A proverb (Lewis & Short s.v. portus): the risk is another’s, and the speaker is safe.

Examples

  • Nunc hujus perīclō fit, ego in portū nāvigō.

    Now it is done at his risk; I am sailing in harbour.Ter. And. 480

See also safe, risk, harbour.

SourcesLewis & Short: portus
